title: Agent bond: example-support-agent
intent: This wallet holds Example Labs's bond on the behavior of its AI agent example-support-agent (Answers customer support questions and issues refunds of up to $50 from the support budget.) under covenant b044cffe97f1f445dca25b3b051778c734dba20bb9590a7bcf1789b3848e0bd9. It pays a slash only for a violation a Verafy jury found, as the covenant prices it; it returns reporter bonds as the rulings say; and after the term it returns the rest of the bond to the operator.
judgment: Does this transaction pay exactly the entitlements named in the case, each one earned under the covenant, its log and verified rulings?
